skills.name: Amortization Schedule Preparation
skills.description: Prepare TValue-style loan amortization schedules with monthly nominal rates, 365-day year irregular first-period interest, year totals, grand totals, APR/finance-charge disclosure summary, and rounding adjustments. Use when preparing or checking vehicle/equipment loan amortization schedules, especially from loan date, rate, payment amount, down payment/trade-in, term, and first payment date.

skills.name: Fillable PDF Form Conversion
skills.description: Convert scanned or image-based PDF forms into precisely aligned fillable PDFs with text fields and checkboxes. Use when a user asks to make a scanned PDF form fillable, overlay AcroForm fields on a non-fillable form, add editable text fields and checkboxes to an existing form, or correct field alignment on a fillable PDF derived from a scan.

skills.name: Xero Bank Statement Import
skills.description: Convert bank statement PDFs into Xero CSV imports that exactly match the user's template, reconcile each month, and emit monthly, combined, and reconciliation outputs. Use when a user provides bank statement PDFs plus a Xero import template and wants transaction extraction, monthly CSVs, a combined CSV, and a reconciliation report.

skills.name: Xero Credit Card Import
skills.description: Extract credit card statement PDFs into Xero-ready bank statement CSVs and reconciliation reports. Use when a user provides statement PDFs plus a Xero import template and wants clean monthly CSVs, a combined CSV, and a month-by-month reconciliation summary.
